propositions: Outbound creates currently use a single construction-time project and fail closed for any other project, preventing legitimate multi-project writes.
The pre-flight cross-project guard compares against a single configured project string rather than the set of projects in the store mapping, incorrectly blocking valid multi-project mutations.
Create target resolution must happen once at mutation build time in _compute_outbound_create_mutation so both Cloud and DC transports receive the correct project via ticket_data.
The reserved _bridge_target_project key must be carried through mutation fields but explicitly dropped in DC's _translate_create_fields to prevent sending invalid Jira field ids.
The cross-project guard must relax to set membership check against mapping.projects and the caller must supply the project set from projects_store.read_projects instead of a single string.
Single-project stores must remain unchanged by falling back to the configured project when the mapping is absent or empty.
